description: This file defines the ReasonerRegistry class, which manages a collection of reasoners. It provides methods to register reasoners, include reasoners from a router, retrieve a reasoner by name, and list all registered reasoners.

classes.name: ReasonerRegistry
classes.description: A registry class for managing reasoners, allowing registration, inclusion from routers, and querying.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new reasoner with a specified name, handler, and optional options.

methods.name: includeRouter
methods.description: Includes reasoners from a given AgentRouter into the registry.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns an array of all registered reasoners.

ctags.name: reasoners
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly reasoners = new Map<string, ReasonerDefinition>();$/

fields.name: private readonly reasoners = new Map<string, ReasonerDefinition>();
